task.name: F3-grid rainfall nowcast skill benchmark
task.question: Does the CNN add skill beyond HKO F3's own two-hour advection nowcast?
task.input: Four F3 half-hourly forecast grids plus one inter-frame change grid over Hong Kong.
task.target: A later F3 lead-0 grid approximately 90–150 minutes after the input snapshot.
task.evaluation: Chronological last-20% holdout; PR-AUC and Brier score against the F3 advection baseline.
task.limitation: The target is a later F3 product, not independent rain-gauge ground truth. Results measure added skill over this proxy baseline only.

blocking_reasons: dataset is missing required arrays: B, label_times, lead_minutes
next_step: Rebuild data/grid_dataset.npz with app/backfill.py using the 5-channel schema and B baseline before running this benchmark.
